text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't Cafe. I just happen to
have finished
developing a drink that
will increase your muscle
mass
significantly...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes, those are my thoughts as well. I will not allow you to drink this... no matter how hard you beg.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Okay? Then if you don't need anything,
do you
mind leaving?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Well, there goes that plan. I had
heard
some people are susceptible to
the Caligula
Effect, or a desire to do
that which is forbidden...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But from your lack of interest, I see that
is not the
case for you. How unfortunate.
I shall have to
look elsewhere for a
volunteer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Well? Are you going or not? Whatever
you're
trying to do, it won't work.
